Procedure:
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Hazem Hafez 
Ahmed Wafa, reviewed eng. Mahmoud Abd El Hamid El Kholi, reviewed by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd El-Qader 
El-Nagar, accepted by Samir Abd El-Gilil, EDEPC MPIS coordinator approved by 
eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha PS and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman admin and financial inspection quality controls general 
director, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Generator isolation 
 and proper earthing is required.
Ensure that the circuit breaker disconnected 
 and secondary disconnect.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes
Complete Tool set, Brushes
Megger, Digital voltmeter
Work to be Carried out
Measurement of service 
 characteristics; such as:
A-Minimum pressure limit.
B-Switching times.
Rearrangement state: Connect all items which 
are disconnected.
